propositions: Bug close reason is currently validated but never persisted, requiring replacement with a required bounded enum `--class` parameter

The `close_class` enum value must be folded into reduced ticket state via a `_fold_close_class` helper in `process_status` on both fork-winner and normal-update branches so it surfaces in `rebar show` output
The `--class` parameter is required on bug closes; omitting it must exit nonzero with error message listing allowed enum values
Validation guards for bug close class exist at two sites (transition_core in txn.py and _completion_precheck in transition_close.py) and must both be updated to accept valid class values
Invalid close_class values outside the bounded enum must be rejected with nonzero exit
The close_class field must be added as optional to ticket_state.schema.json and be queryable after persistence
